```sh
kafka cluster api-versions
```

List the API versions each broker supports and the version this client uses

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Sends ApiVersions to every broker in the cluster metadata, or only the one named by --node. Without --json, prints one kafka-cluster.sh api-versions block per broker: [usable: <version>], UNSUPPORTED when the broker lacks an API this CLI implements, [not implemented] for an API the CLI does not send, and [unusable: no common version].

## Flags

| Flag                 | Description                                          |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>` | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092     |
| `--node <number>`    | describe only this broker id (default: every broker) |

## Examples

```sh
kafka cluster api-versions --brokers localhost:9092
kafka cluster api-versions --node 1 --json
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "brokers": [
    {
      "nodeId": 1,
      "host": "localhost",
      "port": 9092,
      "rack": null,
      "apis": [
        {
          "apiKey": 0,
          "apiName": "Produce",
          "brokerVersions": {
            "minVersion": 0,
            "maxVersion": 13
          },
          "isImplemented": true,
          "version": 13
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
